newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar wavers as U.S. dollar rise pauses.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar wavers as U.S. dollar rise pauses.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar opened a trifle lower on Tuesday but turned higher, lacking clear direction as the U.S. dollar took a breather after its recent surge.
After 30 minutes of trading, the Taiwan dollar was slightly stronger at T$27.478 to the U.S. dollar against Monday's T$27.483 close.
Turnover was a fairly strong US$54 million.
"The Taiwan dollar is trendless," said a foreign bank dealer. "The small fluctuations are basically random."
The somewhat impressive opening volume reflected importers taking positions for fear of the U.S. dollar's continued advance, he said.
In the absence of market-jolting news, the Taiwan dollar was expected to hold its narrow recent range of T$27.465 on the upside and T$27.495 on the downside, the dealer said.
